info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_System Assurance Reviews API
info.description: The System Assurance Reviews API facilitates the submission of reviews related to IT management systems assurance. This endpoint allows users to provide valuable feedback and insights on the performance and reliability of various systems. Typically utilized by IT managers, auditors, and system administrators, this API helps enhance system assessments and ensures compliance with best practices. By capturing reviewer opinions, organizations can foster continuous improvement within their IT infrastructure.

post.summary: Submit a review for the specified system assurance.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the system assurance identified by RES-100045. Ensure that your review adheres to the guidelines provided for effective feedback.
